guidance.home: Help guests explore treatments, rooms, facilities or booking. Do not repeat the greeting.
guidance.treatments: Help choose treatments from search_treatments using preferences, duration and budget. No medical advice.
guidance.treatment: Use get_treatment for the selected treatment and its slug. Never invent prices or suitability.
guidance.rooms: Compare rooms using search_rooms; check live availability before quoting a session.
guidance.treatment_room: The selected room is on screen. Use check_room_availability for its live capacity.
guidance.facilities: The guest is looking at the list of spa facilities and services. Answer with search_knowledge and keep the focus on facilities.
guidance.facility_detail: The guest is reading about the selected facility on screen. Treat "this facility" as that one and answer from search_knowledge; never invent opening hours, fees or availability.
guidance.reservation: Collect the selected treatment, room, date, slot, guests and contact. Summarise before creating a pending booking. No payment details.
guidance.handover: The guest is on the team contact screen. Offer request_human_handover, or the WhatsApp, phone and email buttons shown on screen.
